canonical.title: See — Sandakan & Sepilok: heritage icons, wildlife & coast

parent.title: A first-visit guide to Sandakan & Sepilok

siblings.title: Eat — Sandakan & Sepilok: Where Story Beats Star Count
siblings.summary: A character-first eating map of Sandakan and Sepilok — stilt-village seafood, 'Little Hong Kong' kopitiams, the accidental UFO tart, colonial high tea, and the handful of Sepilok jungle kitchens worth your evenings.

siblings.title: Sleep — Sandakan & Sepilok: character stays from jungle lodges to river camps
siblings.summary: Where to base a first Borneo trip: Sepilok jungle lodges, Kinabatangan river camps, a turtle-island chalet and Sandakan heritage town stays — chosen for character, not category.

siblings.title: Do — Sandakan & Sepilok: wildlife, river, caves & history
siblings.summary: The accessible, semi-adventurous Sandakan/Sepilok playbook: Sepilok's wildlife trio, the Kinabatangan cruise, caves, turtles and the town's WWII history.

siblings.title: Offbeat Sandakan & Sepilok: ghosts, croquet, cow-dung tarts & a 2-million-bat exodus
siblings.summary: The quirky layer of Sandakan & Sepilok — bombed-flat 'Little Hong Kong', a leper-island POW escape, a colonial croquet lawn, cow-dung-shaped tarts, and natural oddities from bat exodus to palm-estate monkeys.

siblings.title: Culture in Sandakan & Sepilok: museums, temples, markets & festivals (with dates)
siblings.summary: Sandakan's colonial-port culture decoded: museums, Chinese temples, the war memorial, water-village markets and a full festival calendar with 2026 dates to time your visit.

siblings.title: Around & day-trips: Sandakan & Sepilok logistics
siblings.summary: Practical hops in, out and around Sandakan/Sepilok plus a costed day-trip orbit for a first Borneo visit.

sources.title: Sandakan Heritage Trail — Sabah Tourism
sources.claim: Sandakan Heritage Trail links restored colonial buildings and places of worship; ~1.5-2h walk

sources.title: Sandakan City Heritage Trail self-guided walking tour
sources.claim: Trail stop order from Jamik Mosque through 100 Steps, Agnes Keith, temples; walk early or after 3pm

sources.title: Sandakan Heritage Trail — Malaysia Traveller
sources.claim: St Michael's is one of few stone buildings in Sabah, Gothic style, construction begun 1893

sources.title: Sam Sing Kung Temple — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Sam Sing Kung built 1887, third-oldest temple in Sandakan; Goddess of Mercy (1868) is oldest

sources.title: Sandakan's 138-year-old Sam Sing Kung Temple
sources.claim: Original bronze bell donated by Fung Ming Shan, Sandakan's first Kapitan Cina (1887)

sources.title: Agnes Keith House — Sabah Tourism
sources.claim: Agnes Keith House (Newlands) was home of author of 'Land Below The Wind' (1939); opened as museum 26 Apr 2004

sources.title: Agnes Keith House — Hello Sabah
sources.claim: Agnes Keith House open daily 9am-5pm; non-Malaysian entry RM15

sources.title: English Tea House — next to Agnes Keith House
sources.claim: English Tea House sits next to Agnes Keith House for colonial-style afternoon tea and scones

sources.title: Sandakan Memorial Park — Wikipedia
sources.claim: On former POW camp grounds; 2,434 Allied POWs died, only 6 Australians survived, 1945

sources.title: Sandakan Memorial Park — Sabah Tourism
sources.claim: Free, open daily; Commemorative Pavilion opened 1999; 15 August memorial service

sources.title: The history of the Sandakan Death Marches
sources.claim: More than 1,000 POWs force-marched 260km to Ranau; about half died en route

sources.title: Puu Jih Shih Temple — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Hilltop Buddhist temple at Tanah Merah, largest Chinese temple in town, built 1987, ~4km west

sources.title: Puu Jih Shih Temple — MySabah
sources.claim: Commanding sunset views over Sandakan Bay and the Sulu Sea; best in late afternoon

sources.title: Buli Sim Sim Water Village
sources.claim: Stilt water village, site of original 1879 Sandakan town, with seafood restaurants

sources.title: Sandakan destination — Klook
sources.claim: Central Market and Sim Sim offer local cuisine and grilled seafood at reasonable prices

sources.title: Best of Sepilok Orangutan Centre — Ecotour Malaysia
sources.claim: Feeding sessions 10am and 3pm; non-Malaysian entry RM30 plus RM10 camera fee

sources.title: Sepilok Orangutan Rehabilitation Centre — Orangutan Appeal UK
sources.claim: Orangutans are wild and free-ranging; sightings at feeds are never guaranteed

sources.title: Bornean Sun Bear Conservation Centre — Visit Us
sources.claim: BSBCC sits in the Kabili-Sepilok Forest Reserve next to the orangutan centre

sources.title: Bornean Sun Bear Conservation Centre — Wikipedia
sources.claim: The world's only sun bear conservation centre, founded 2008, opened to public 2014

sources.title: RDC Canopy Walkway
sources.claim: 620m canopy skywalk, longest in Sabah, up to 27m above the forest floor

sources.title: Rainforest Discovery Center, Sepilok — Girl on a Zebra
sources.claim: Open 8am-5pm; non-resident adult RM30; night walk RM50; 23km from Sandakan

sources.title: Labuk Bay Proboscis Monkey Sanctuary — Visit
sources.claim: Feeds Platform A 9:30am & 2:30pm, Platform B 11:30am & 4:30pm; open 8am-6pm daily

sources.title: Labuk Bay Proboscis Monkey Sanctuary — Tickets
sources.claim: Adult ticket RM60, child RM30, photo fee RM10

sources.title: Turtle Islands Park — Sabah Parks
sources.claim: 40km north of Sandakan; Selingan, Gulisan, Bakungan Kechil; green and hawksbill nesting

sources.title: Selingan Island — Borneo Adventure
sources.claim: Turtles ashore nightly year-round; overnight stay recommended for nesting and hatchling release

sources.title: Selingan Turtle Island — Malaysia Uncovered
sources.claim: Limited to ~50 visitors per night; pre-booking essential; peak nesting July-October

sources.title: Turtle Island Borneo guide — The Family Freestylers
sources.claim: Book as far ahead as possible; early-April tours sold out off-peak; permits via Crystal Quest

sources.title: Selingan Turtle Island — Crystal Quest
sources.claim: Official Selingan turtle-watching overnight tour package operator

sources.title: Gomantong Caves — eTawau
sources.claim: Sabah's largest edible bird's-nest cave; Simud Hitam ceilings to 90m; harvested Feb-Apr, Jul-Sep

sources.title: Gomantong Cave — Sandakan Rainforest Lodge
sources.claim: ~1.5h drive from Sandakan; ~2 million bats exit at dusk; boardwalks access the caves

sources.title: Kinabatangan River Cruise — Girl on a Zebra
sources.claim: Best done as an overnight lodge stay with dusk, dawn and night cruises

sources.title: Sandakan-Gomantong-Kinabatangan package — Amazing Borneo
sources.claim: Gomantong and Kinabatangan combined; June and September 2026 peak surcharge

sources.title: Lankayan Island — Sipadan.com
sources.claim: Luxury private dive island ~90 min boat from Sandakan; beach and over-water chalets

sources.title: Lankayan Island Package — Borneo Dream
sources.claim: Boat transfer daily in peak (Jul-Sep), 3x/week otherwise; multi-day dive packages

sources.title: Best time to visit Sandakan — Sabah Guide
sources.claim: Drier months March-September; NE monsoon Oct-Feb brings heaviest east-coast rain

sources.title: Best time to travel to Sabah — CLL Adventure Borneo
sources.claim: NE monsoon Oct-Feb brings heavier rain to the east coast incl. Sandakan and Kinabatangan

sources.title: Best time to visit Sabah — Responsible Travel
sources.claim: General Sabah best-time guidance; avoid heaviest rains for outdoor and sea activities

sources.title: Kota Kinabalu to Sandakan — Girl on a Zebra
sources.claim: ~2h50 flight from Kuala Lumpur or ~45 min from Kota Kinabalu (Firefly)

sources.title: Sandakan to Sepilok — A Social Nomad
sources.claim: Sepilok ~25km from Sandakan; local bus RM4 (~45 min) or taxi/Grab ~RM50

sources.title: Sandakan airport to Sepilok — Sabah Tourism
sources.claim: Official guidance on transfers between Sandakan airport/town and Sepilok

sources.title: Pulau Selingan — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Part of Turtle Islands National Park, a sanctuary for green and hawksbill turtles

sources.title: BSBCC tickets — Trip.com
sources.claim: BSBCC tickets bookable online; sits beside the orangutan centre in Sepilok

sources.title: Kinabatangan Wildlife River Cruise — MAM Holidays
sources.claim: Lodges offer 2-night packages with ~4 cruises plus night and dawn walking safaris

sources.title: Agnes Keith House — Sabah Museum
sources.claim: Agnes Keith House is an official Sabah Museum site on Jalan Istana hill

sources.title: Sandakan Heritage Trail — CLL Adventure Borneo
sources.claim: The 100 Steps connect the lower town to the colonial hilltop with bay views
